ambiguities.source_text: Calculate the Percent of Total customers in each category, rounded to 1 decimal place
ambiguities.ref:
total = len(df)
percent = (counts / total * 100).round(1).rename("% of Total")
ambiguities.intent: Divide category customer count by all input customers, multiply by 100, and round to one decimal place.

ambiguities.source_text: Calculate the Average Ratings for each platform for each customer
ambiguities.ref:
mobile_cols = [
		"Mobile App - Ease of Use",
		"Mobile App - Ease of Access",
		"Mobile App - Navigation",
		"Mobile App - Likelihood to Recommend",
	]
online_cols = [
		"Online Interface - Ease of Use",
		"Online Interface - Ease of Access",
		"Online Interface - Navigation",
		"Online Interface - Likelihood to Recommend",
	]

df["avg_mobile"] = df[mobile_cols].mean(axis=1)
df["avg_online"] = df[online_cols].mean(axis=1)
ambiguities.intent: Average the four non-overall ratings separately for each platform; exclude both Overall Rating columns.

ambiguities.source_text: Calculate the difference in Average Rating between Mobile App and Online Interface
ambiguities.intent: Subtract the Online Interface mean from the Mobile App mean.

ambiguities.source_text: Categorise each customer into exactly one of the following groups based on the difference:
ambiguities.intent: Use mutually exclusive bands: >=2 Mobile App Superfan; >=1 and <2 Mobile App Fan; <=-2 Online Interface Superfan; <=-1 and >-2 Online Interface Fan; otherwise Neutral.
Keep the full requirement ordering: Mobile App Fan, Neutral, Mobile App Superfan, Online Interface Fan, Online Interface Superfan.
ambiguities.ref:
order = [
		"Mobile App Fan",
		"Neutral",
		"Mobile App Superfan",
		"Online Interface Fan",
		"Online Interface Superfan",
	]
out = out.set_index("Preference").reindex(order).reset_index()
